context:
STYLE BIBLE (mandatory for every image concept) — "The Independent Bill Auditor"
Flat ledger surfaces, engineering-blueprint feel. NO gradients, no glassmorphism, no 3D renders, no stock-photo people smiling at bills. Monospaced type is the voice of numbers. Palette: ink #0e201c, cream paper #fffcfa, faint grid-teal #3c655c scaffolding, amber #e8a33d reserved for THE ONE LINE THAT MATTERS (a highlighted figure, the key step, the flagged charge). Charts render data honestly; annotations look hand-entered by an auditor. Human figures, when used, are distant/schematic, never decorative.

IMAGE MECHANICS ON THIS SITE
- Hero: frontmatter `image:` field; file under static/images/articles/<slug>/; full intrinsic aspect ratio (16:9 or 3:2). Some pages support `hero_below_answer: true`.
- In-body editorial figures: {{< visual src="/images/articles/<slug>/<name>.webp" alt="honest descriptive alt" caption="optional" wide="16:9-or-wide" >}} — honest alt mandatory.
- Product visuals: product-box shortcode auto-renders from data/product_images.yaml keyed by ASIN (all 12 wired ASINs have entries + on-disk files — verified). Inline: {{< amazon asin="..." text="..." >}}.
- AFFILIATE RULE (binding): any image whose subject is a product we recommend must be affiliate-wired — inside/near a {{< product-box >}} or wrapped in a {{< amazon > }} link. NEVER a bare un-monetized figure of a recommended product. AI product images must be visually accurate to the REAL product's form factor.
- VERIFIED ASIN INVENTORY (the only ASINs allowed): Kill A Watt P4400 B00009MDBU · Kasa KP115 B08LN3C7WK · Kasa KP125MP2 B0BYGRLRS1 · Tapo P110M B0DKGBP38V · Emporia plug B0CLVV7X7Y · Emporia Vue 3 B0C7B1LKDW · Nest Learning B0D5BBYRJM · ecobee Premium B09XXS48P8 · Moen Flo B00C03D01Q · Emporia L2 EV B09ZNN3JB7 · Govee leak detectors B0DQLFC3Q6 · Honeywell X2P B0DSGGDCR8. NEVER invent an ASIN.
- CRISIS-PAGE PROHIBITION: NO product placement on past-due/shutoff/reconnection crisis pages (21-past-due-balance in this set = NO box ever).

SQ-057 CONTEXT (this tier's journey lattice, already live in the markdown)
All 10 pages: FAQ+schema present, Related Reading present, guided endings, moment-of-need body links (30->85 unique). Dead zones broken. The 14-day Rybbit watch is pending deploy. Heroes exist on 9/10 (frontmatter image:); body visuals only on 08-TOU (time-of-use-clock.webp) and how-to-read-a-water-meter (dial-meter-reading.webp). Existing non-hero assets unwired on disk: 21-past-due (past-due-bill-anatomy.webp, past-due-disconnection-timeline.webp).

YOUR PAGES (write one plan each):
1. 01-how-to-read-your-electric-bill (1709w, the tier's best reader 69.2s; hero custom_hero.webp; bill-anatomy figure is the centerpiece (a labeled statement); kWh explanation had the 114w dead zone; NO box — definitional hub)
2. how-to-read-electric-meter (1071w; hero exists; dial-meter reading sequence is THE action demo (sweep dials, direction alternation); two-readings subtraction example; possible Kill A Watt B00009MDBU fit only if honest — the page is about the UTILITY meter, a plug-in monitor is a different job; judge strictly)
3. 21-past-due-balance (1175w; hero + TWO UNWIRED assets on disk: past-due-bill-anatomy.webp, past-due-disconnection-timeline.webp — VIEW BOTH and judge wiring them in vs replacing; CRISIS PAGE: absolutely no product box; timeline/notice-deadline figures reduce panic and keep readers)

PLAN FORMAT per page (mirror the exemplar): Hero (file, VIEWED description, verdict SUITABLE/WITH-NOTES/REPLACE) · Current state (body-visual count, orphan assets on disk) · Recommended plan (total in the 3-7 band, justified by word count + density; numbered placements table: exact section heading, concept, purpose, format/orientation, type, affiliate-wired y/n, proposed filename) · Not-planned (earn-their-place rejects) · Cohesion note (how the set reads as one visual grammar, cross-page consistency with siblings).
ENGAGEMENT STRATEGY (the point of this mission): every planned image must serve retention or conversion — place at (a) the answer moment (make the first-screen answer glanceable), (b) action moments (show the reader the thing they're about to DO — a meter dial, a dye test, a bill line), (c) residual dense spots (tables/math that a figure clarifies), (d) the pre-exit moment (last figure earns the scroll to Related Reading). Name the retention mechanism per image. Images must CLARIFY or DEMONSTRATE, never decorate.
AFFILIATE STRATEGY: pages with an existing product box (or a defensible new one from the verified inventory + AFFILIATE-PLACEMENTS rules — no crisis pages) get an affiliate-wired row: the product image must be accurate to the real product. Propose at most ONE new box per page; where you propose one, include the exact product-box shortcode + placement + rationale. When in doubt, NONE — a wrong box costs trust.
